$comment: Who has a Rock Database login (decisions 179 to 182). The Cast's logins are hand-written in cast/households. Generated adults get one with the chance of their strongest reason below. No measured source counts logins, so every share here is designed, with its reason; the verify tool reports the real counts. Logins load only when the person installing gives a password, and every login uses it. No password or hash is ever in a package.

reasons.why: A church app device tied to a person means they signed in to the app. Counts only when communications load, since the app is part of them.
Each campus pastor is staff, in RSR - Staff Workers and RSR - Pastoral Workers, and writes notes.
Small group leaders and serving team leaders use Rock's group and scheduling tools, which need a login.
Most churches have givers set up and change a scheduled gift in their account.

Praying through requests online needs a login, and group sync puts the prayer team in RSR - Prayer Access, a security role (decision D-group-sync-4). Counts only when prayer loads, since the prayer team is part of it.
Volunteers accept and decline in the Group Schedule Toolbox, though some only answer texts and emails.
Many one-time online givers give as guests.
Some join through Group Finder with an account.
Connected, Engaged, and Leading adults sign up for events and update their profiles.
Participants and Known adults have done one or two things.
Prospects have filled out a form at most.
